handoff.objective: Complete five ranked ECC experiment contracts with corrected definitions and reproducible controls so the reserve can reach eight justified ready experiments.
constraints: You are not alone in this worktree. Own only the six artifact_paths. Preserve other edits and all existing scientific records. No commits, push, measurements, fixture search or code execution of experiment drivers.

This is prospective Coordinator contract design under standing user authorization, not an evidence review. Draft complete additive replacements at the reserved paths with approved_by null; parent Coordinator archives and then decides formal approval. Do not edit official hypotheses or claim independent validation.

Read the five source specifications, linked proposals/hypotheses, nearest code and knowledge frontier. Preserve each original mechanism and state every substantive change and source binding. If a full design is impossible, record the exact missing technical ingredient and a bounded next action; no vague pending approval.

Every contract must specify exact input selection, seeds, complete parameter cell count and run definition, functions and exceptional points, controls, metrics including zero denominators, cost/memory measurement, stopping/invalidation rules, required run artifacts, and positive/negative/inconclusive next decisions. Statistical model mismatch is an observation, not by itself an implementation failure.

Resolve spectral real-cosine two-peak control, null half-energy normalization and family-wise finite-sample testing; sumset pair normalization and subgroup-control exceptions; p-adic Teichmuller precision and torsion-section formulas with point-at-infinity/zero-coordinate conventions; walk stationary weighting/nontrivial singular-value definition and conditioning/search costs; BSGS exact shared-instance/reuse and enforceable memory semantics and stochastic rho comparison.

Use primary retrieved sources for niche external facts; record citation provenance per AGENTS. Recollections cannot support decisions. Internal algebra derivations may be stated as derivations, never fabricated validated findings. Include proof_search_map audits with explicit non-applicability reasons if appropriate; novelty remains unverified unless actually checked.

Check nearest frontier rows across time, memory and data/queries. Record actual comparison and quantitative sota_delta; unknown comparisons stay unknown rather than inventing an unchecked dominated_by null. Designs are diagnostic toy scope unless a justified broader statement is explicit.

Maximum scientific runs zero. Read-only source/code/schema inspection and symbolic paper derivation permitted; do not run scientific controls or simulations as unit tests. Time/CPU are advisory; memory cap 8GB, one worker. Stop after complete six-file package or a truthful bounded partial package.

No official experiment approval or execution handoff is granted by this design task. Do not silently introduce dependencies that make a purported ready contract unusable. Report actual tool availability and requested/native model provenance; no Bedrock or fabricated probe.
completion_gate: Six exact files exist with five independently useful contracts or exact technical impediments.
Original records and other producer scope unchanged; no scientific runs or evidence/status claims.
